modules.name: Master Agent Factory
modules.description: Master builder for assembling full production agent instances from identity, gateway, memory, tools, and security layers.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.factory import AgentFactory
agent = AgentFactory.create_agent(config, manifest, gateway=gateway, tools=tool_registry)

modules.name: Agent Identity & Configuration
modules.description: Agent identity specifications, manifests, environment configurations, and cost/retry policies.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.identity import AgentIdentity, AgentConfig, AgentManifest
identity = AgentIdentity(agent_id='agent-01', name='Researcher')

modules.name: LLM Gateway & Multi-Provider Router
modules.description: Unified LLM gateway with model routing by task complexity, multi-provider fallbacks, streaming, and tool call normalization.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.gateway import LLMGateway, LLMRequest, TaskComplexity
gateway = LLMGateway()
res = await gateway.complete(LLMRequest(messages=[...], complexity=TaskComplexity.SIMPLE))

modules.name: Token Tracker & Cost Economics
modules.description: Token usage tracking, multi-model pricing economics, per-run cost recording, and budget limit enforcement.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.cost import CostManager
cost_mgr = CostManager()
cost_mgr.record_usage('gpt-4o', prompt_tokens=150, completion_tokens=50)

modules.name: Prompt Manager & Injection Defense
modules.description: Dynamic prompt template compilation, versioning, canary tokens for system prompt leakage detection, and prompt injection filtering.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.prompt import PromptManager, PromptInjectionDefense
prompt_mgr = PromptManager()
defense = PromptInjectionDefense()

modules.name: Reliability, Loop Detection & Idempotency
modules.description: Exponential backoff retries, cycle/loop detection, execution resource bounds, and idempotency guarantees.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.reliability import LoopDetector, ResourceLimits
detector = LoopDetector(threshold=3)
detector.record_step('action_hash')

modules.name: Security, RBAC & Secret Isolation
modules.description: Role-based access control, tool risk categorization (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL), SSRF IP/domain validation, and zero-leak secret isolation.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.security import RiskLevel, SSRFValidator, SecretStore
SSRFValidator.validate_url('https://api.github.com')

modules.name: Agent Execution State & Persistence
modules.description: Execution context state machine, step tracking, intermediate results, and checkpoint persistence.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.state import ExecutionContext
ctx = ExecutionContext(run_id='run-123')

modules.name: Agent Versioning & Canary Rollout
modules.description: Semantic agent version management, canary traffic splitting, and automated rollback on regression.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.core.lifecycle import CanaryDeploymentManager
canary = CanaryDeploymentManager()

modules.name: Conversation Engine & Multi-turn Threads
modules.description: Multi-turn conversation management, message history formatting, and automated context compaction for large dialogues.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.memory.conversation import ConversationEngine
conv = ConversationEngine()
conv.add_user_message('thread-1', 'Hello')

modules.name: Working Memory & Scratchpad
modules.description: Short-term scratchpad memory storing active goals, discovered findings, completed steps, and task scratchpad notes.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.memory.working import WorkingMemory
wm = WorkingMemory(objective='Analyze data')
wm.add_finding('Key insight found')

modules.name: Semantic Memory & Vector Retrieval
modules.description: In-memory semantic vector store, text chunking, and cosine similarity ranking for agent knowledge.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.memory.semantic import SemanticMemory
sm = SemanticMemory()
await sm.store('text document', metadata={'source': 'doc1'})
results = await sm.search('query', top_k=3)

modules.name: Episodic Memory & Experience Learning
modules.description: Stores historical task execution episodes, failures, successes, and derived lessons learned for future task improvement.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.memory.episodic import EpisodicMemory, Episode
em = EpisodicMemory()
em.record_episode(Episode(task='deploy', outcome='success', lessons=['always check env vars']))

modules.name: Hybrid RAG Engine (BM25 + Dense Vectors)
modules.description: Hybrid retrieval augmented generation combining lexical BM25 indexing with dense semantic vector search and reciprocal rank fusion.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.memory.rag import RAGEngine
rag = RAGEngine()
await rag.ingest_documents([{'content': 'AI agent guide', 'id': 'doc1'}])
results = await rag.query('agent architecture')

modules.name: Memory Governance, PII Redaction & Context Builder
modules.description: PII scrubbing (emails, credit cards, phones, SSNs), TTL retention pruning, and assembled context token budgeting.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.memory.governance import MemoryGovernance, ContextBuilder
scrubbed = MemoryGovernance.redact_pii('Contact john@example.com')

modules.name: Central Tool Registry & Dispatcher
modules.description: Central registry registering tools, generating standardized JSON tool schemas for LLMs, checking permissions, and dispatching execution.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.tools.registry import ToolRegistry
registry = ToolRegistry()
registry.register(my_tool)
schemas = registry.get_schemas()

modules.name: Base Tool Contract & Specification
modules.description: Abstract base class for all tools with JSON schema extraction, risk levels, and standardized ToolExecutionResult wrapper.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.tools.base import BaseTool, ToolExecutionResult
class MyTool(BaseTool): ...

modules.name: Human Approval & HITL Workflows
modules.description: Human-in-the-loop approval queue intercepting HIGH and CRITICAL risk tool executions before dispatch.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.tools.approval import HumanApprovalQueue
queue = HumanApprovalQueue()
req = queue.request_approval(tool_name='delete_database', args={...})

modules.name: Web Search Tool
modules.description: Structured search tool for external information gathering with query parameters, filtering, and result summaries.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.tools.builtins.search import WebSearchTool
search = WebSearchTool()
result = await search.execute(query='latest python features')

modules.name: Browser Action Tool with SSRF Defense
modules.description: Web browser automation tool with URL sanitization, domain allow/deny list, and private network SSRF defenses.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.tools.builtins.browser import BrowserTool
browser = BrowserTool()
page = await browser.execute(url='https://example.com')

modules.name: Hardened Python Sandbox Tool
modules.description: AST-inspected, isolated Python code execution tool restricting dangerous builtins, modules, and excessive CPU/memory runtime.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.tools.builtins.code_exec import PythonSandboxTool
sandbox = PythonSandboxTool()
res = await sandbox.execute(code='result = [x**2 for x in range(10)]')

modules.name: Document & File Processing Tool
modules.description: File parser and reader supporting text, markdown, CSV, JSON, and PDF text extraction with strict path traversal prevention.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.tools.builtins.files import FileProcessingTool
files = FileProcessingTool()
content = await files.execute(file_path='data/report.json')

modules.name: Planning Engine & Task Decomposition
modules.description: Breaks complex user goals into sequential/parallel dependency DAG steps, handles dynamic re-planning on step failures.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.orchestration.planner import PlanningEngine
planner = PlanningEngine(gateway=gateway)
plan = await planner.create_plan('Build customer support workflow')

modules.name: Workflow Execution Engine (DAG Orchestrator)
modules.description: Directed acyclic graph execution engine supporting parallel branches, dependency resolution, error traps, and conditional routing.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.orchestration.workflow import WorkflowEngine
engine = WorkflowEngine()
res = await engine.execute_dag(dag_definition)

modules.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration & Supervisor
modules.description: Agent-to-agent communication protocol, message passing, peer collaboration, and hierarchical supervisor orchestration.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.orchestration.multi_agent import MultiAgentOrchestrator, SupervisorAgent
supervisor = SupervisorAgent(workers=[worker1, worker2])

modules.name: Event Bus, Trigger Engine & Job Queue
modules.description: Asynchronous publish-subscribe event bus, event triggers for automated agent dispatch, and background job queuing.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.orchestration.events import EventBus, AgentEvent
bus = EventBus()
bus.subscribe('order.created', handler_fn)

modules.name: Structured Output Engine & Schema Enforcer
modules.description: Extracts and validates JSON outputs against Pydantic models, automatically repairing broken JSON and syntax mismatches.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.validation.structured import StructuredOutputEngine
validator = StructuredOutputEngine()
model_obj = validator.parse_and_validate(raw_llm_text, target_pydantic_cls)

modules.name: Self-Verification & Fact Checking
modules.description: Multi-pass verification validating LLM responses against source material, checking hallucinations and factual alignment.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.validation.verification import SelfVerificationEngine
verifier = SelfVerificationEngine(gateway=gateway)
result = await verifier.verify_claims(answer, context_docs)

modules.name: Citation Engine & Source Provenance
modules.description: Maps claims and generated statements back to verified document source IDs, line ranges, or URLs.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.validation.citations import CitationEngine
citations = CitationEngine()
annotated = citations.link_citations(generated_text, retrieved_sources)

modules.name: Distributed Tracing & Span Trees
modules.description: Hierarchical span tracing for agent thought loops, LLM calls, tool executions, and timing diagnostics.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.observability.tracer import Tracer
tracer = Tracer()
with tracer.start_span('agent_step'): ...

modules.name: Security Audit Logging
modules.description: Tamper-evident audit logging for tool executions, privilege elevations, policy rejections, and access logs.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.observability.audit import AuditLogger
audit = AuditLogger()
audit.log_event(action='tool_call', user_id='usr_123', risk='MEDIUM')

modules.name: Operational Metrics & Analytics
modules.description: Tracks latency distributions, token usage, tool success/failure ratios, and cost velocity.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.observability.metrics import AgentAnalytics
analytics = AgentAnalytics()
snapshot = analytics.get_snapshot()

modules.name: Golden Evaluation Datasets & Test Cases
modules.description: Golden test case schema, expected outputs, ground truth rubrics, and dataset serialization.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.evaluation.dataset import GoldenDataset, TestCase
ds = GoldenDataset(name='qa_tests')
ds.add_test(TestCase(prompt='...', expected='...'))

modules.name: LLM-as-Judge & Rubric Scoring
modules.description: Automated qualitative evaluation scoring agent outputs on accuracy, clarity, safety, and helpfulness (1-5 scale).
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.evaluation.judge import LLMAsJudge
judge = LLMAsJudge(gateway=gateway)
scorecard = await judge.evaluate(prompt, response, ground_truth)

modules.name: Regression Benchmark Runner
modules.description: Automated benchmark suite running GoldenDatasets against agent instances and generating pass/fail reports.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.evaluation.regression import RegressionRunner
runner = RegressionRunner(agent_instance)
report = await runner.run_benchmark(golden_dataset)

modules.name: Production FastAPI Agent Server
modules.description: REST API, Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming endpoint, and webhook callback integration for agents.
modules.usage_example:
import uvicorn
# Run with: uvicorn agent_factory.api.server:app --port 8000

modules.name: API Auth, Tenant Resolution & HMAC Webhooks
modules.description: Bearer token authentication, multi-tenant isolation, rate limiting, and HMAC signature verification for webhooks.
modules.usage_example:
from agent_factory.api.auth import RateLimiter, verify_webhook_signature
limiter = RateLimiter(requests_per_minute=60)

modules.name: Deep Research Agent Template
modules.description: Pre-configured ready-to-run Deep Web Search, Fact-Checking, and Citation Research Agent.
modules.usage_example:
from templates.research_agent import create_research_agent
agent = create_research_agent()
result = await agent.run('Investigate latest quantum computing breakthroughs')

modules.name: Content Strategy Agent Template
modules.description: Pre-configured Content Strategy, Tone-of-Voice, and SEO Writing Agent.
modules.usage_example:
from templates.content_agent import create_content_agent
agent = create_content_agent()
result = await agent.run('Draft product announcement blog post')

modules.name: Data Analysis & Coding Agent Template
modules.description: Pre-configured Python Sandbox, Data Analysis, and Code Execution Agent.
modules.usage_example:
from templates.coding_agent import create_coding_agent
agent = create_coding_agent()
result = await agent.run('Calculate summary statistics from dataset')
